Swim — rainbow goby fins — face normals before and after the fix

MOCKUP — SOFTWARE RE-RENDER OF ENGINE POSES, NOT A DEVICE CAPTURE

What this shows

The real mesh wflevels/aquarium_plants/rainbow_goby_fins.iff, posed by the engine's own deformer (deformer_golden steps), drawn twice: with the rest-pose normals the engine kept before the fix, and with normals recomputed after every pose.

Culling is the engine's test (dropped when N·(centre − eye) > 0); one hard white light, flat faces. The magenta background shows through wherever a face is missing.

Hole: front face culled by a stale normal
Outline: face whose cull decision is wrong
Light follows the stored normal

Camera: of 256 directions, the one where the faces that change cover the most screen at the extreme pose.

Stats per panel: wrongly culled / wrongly drawn faces, and the largest normal error (component).
